decision.reason: The cited item [ev-2bbc505de6bb] combines two separate breaking changes, and a single typed assertion can't cover both. The first is the removal of the controllers' wildcard view RBAC, replaced by a binding to the `view` role, which may affect reports and mutate/generate policies on custom resources [ev-01e97dc9c4df]. The second is that policy exceptions are no longer enabled in all namespaces by default, which affects anyone relying on that (CVE-2024-48921) [ev-dea2079e5dc4]. Even taken separately, gaps remain: the Helm values for wildcard permissions are only referenced ('as specified below') and not shown, and the new default of `features.policyExceptions.namespace` is not stated. The rendered CRD diffs (apiCall.default fields, removal of v2alpha1 versions) belong to other changes and cover neither topic, so the item should be split and the missing values/defaults sourced.
